scope: Repository evidence only; no new external acquisition.

infrastructure_contract.rule: A source-addressable observation remains visible whether it is canonical, staged, intake-only, held, inferred, unavailable, or not searched. Promotion state changes the label; it does not delete the data.

inventory.interpretation: These counts describe different record types and universes. They are displayed side by side, never collapsed into one misleading total. The canonical receipt count includes eleven immutable structured extracts used only for the first two thesis case-intake custody packets; those extracts add no hop, finding, promoted thesis evidence, review clearance, or graph effect. Live crawl and fanout counts are monotonic lower bounds because official-record intake may advance independently. The canonical surface denominator keeps the Electric Twin institutional seed-round record non-hop, preserving LocalGlobe as an organization without substituting Saul Klein or another principal. It admits the complete five-person Centre for Human Progress director-appointment roster as one exact-date formal officer surface while keeping Michael Muthukrishna’s separate Electric Twin adviser chronology single-actor and graph-inert. It also separates Detachment 201’s organization-level military advisory program from the exact inaugural four-person commissioning event: only the four named officers generate six official same-day bases, while the program context cannot manufacture procurement, company, or Clifford adjacency. A second exact commissioning act on 10 June 2026 preserves Dane Knecht, Sam Pullara, and Serkan Piantino as the three commissioned officers and Daniel P. Driscoll as the role-distinct oath administrator. Those four directly named event actors produce exactly six same-day bases, while civilian employers, Cohort 1 historical references, unallocated project-influence claims, and continuing program context remain outside the event denominator. It now also preserves the Matt Clifford–Anduril question as four exact, graph-inert official events: Clifford’s summit appointment, Anduril’s separate 17 October roundtable, Clifford’s separate 25 October roundtable, and the organization-only TALOS Phase 3 contract observation. Those records expose process proximity and procurement chronology while refusing to manufacture a shared event, bilateral contact, or Clifford procurement effect. The Dialog composite is split into an exact-date dense directory observation, three reported leadership-role observations, and Matt Clifford's reported invitation/non-attendance boundary; none creates an actor hop. It now also exposes a source-native Anduril UK chronology: three exact-date actor surfaces for the Drake–Shenk company appointments, the Sawyers–Kausner TALOS announcement, and the Healey–Drake Ukraine deal announcement; organization-only awards, frameworks, and competitive shortlists remain explicit refusals. The all-time Drake-to-Clifford route is cross-date and cannot be presented as contemporaneous or as a direct Clifford–Anduril instrument. It now also admits the exact five-person Atlantic Bastion launch-publication cohort on 8 December 2025 while preserving the wider 20-company and 26-proposal programme denominator as organization-only context. The publication basis does not establish universal physical co-attendance, contract participation, selection authority, or a direct Matt Clifford instrument. It now also admits the exact seven-person Frontier AI Taskforce External Advisory Board appointment cohort on 7 September 2023. The formal co-appointment creates twenty-one official one-day bases, while the source terms keep employer representation, later attendance, continuous tenure, and procurement participation outside the event denominator. It now also admits one official, exact-date Entrepreneur First cofounder observation on 5 July 2018, naming Alice Bentinck and Matt Clifford through the source-reported 2011 founding relationship while refusing to invent an exact founding day, continuous tenure, current ownership, or participation in every Entrepreneur First programme. It now also preserves UK Covid-19 Inquiry document INQ000195879 as one exact-date email-routing surface between Ben Warner, Dominic Cummings, and Imran Shafi, while keeping the 2016 Vote Leave / ASI Data Science record organization-only. It now also admits the 27 September 2025 Electric Twin CS01 as a graph-inert registered-holder-state surface. The filing establishes exact registered names, classes, quantities, and date-bounded qualifying holdings while refusing allottee, beneficial-ownership, transfer, consideration, rights-exercise, and shared-participation inferences.

lanes.label: Clifford, Starmer, Dialog, Thiel, and Palantir core
lanes.what_the_data_shows: The canonical graph contains source-native, date-bounded UK policy, corporate, defence appointment, procurement-publication, and programme-launch surfaces. It now includes the official Clifford-Starmer Action Plan hop, the Faculty company bridge, exact Anduril UK officer and named-announcement surfaces, and the five-person Atlantic Bastion launch-publication cohort, alongside inspectable refusals for organization-only awards, frameworks, shortlists, wider programme rosters, and unresolved supplier identity. It also contains the official seven-person Frontier AI Taskforce External Advisory Board appointment surface, giving the six other named appointees one exact formal hop to Matt Clifford. It also contains the official 5 July 2018 Entrepreneur First cofounder observation, giving Alice Bentinck one direct, exact-date formal basis to Matt Clifford without extending that observation into a continuous company relationship. It now also distinguishes the refused 2016 Vote Leave personal shortcut from an exact 8 March 2020 UK Covid-19 Inquiry email-routing surface joining Ben Warner, Dominic Cummings, and Imran Shafi; the later No. 10 communication does not backfill campaign participation.
lanes.open_join: No official record in the current corpus places Matt Clifford and an Anduril actor on one shared meeting, submission, procurement, review, approval, or implementation instrument. Atlantic Bastion adds a second official Healey-Drake publication basis and three new defence-industry principals, but every route to Clifford remains cross-date rather than direct or contemporaneous.

lanes.label: NatSec100 U.S. defense-company universe
lanes.what_the_data_shows: A multi-year defense-company universe and conversion-event ledger exists even though it has not been promoted into the canonical Clifford hop graph. Three editions are complete at 100 rows; the 2025 edition is explicitly partial at 42 rows.
lanes.open_join: The 58 unrecovered 2025 roster rows remain a declared coverage gap, not evidence that those companies did not exist.

lanes.label: Austin-Israel defense and venture corridor
lanes.what_the_data_shows: The Capital Factory 837-company universe was crossed against 196 NatSec100 companies, producing 12 source-explicit co-listings and four independently corroborated cases. Pallas, Silent Ventures, a source-explicit Austin-Israel cohort, Stratos, and three company deep dives remain separately visible.
lanes.open_join: Portfolio listing is not silently rewritten as equity investment; absence on searched Capital Factory-Stratos surfaces is not rewritten as a proven negative.

lanes.label: People routing between government, funds, companies, and awards
lanes.what_the_data_shows: A denominator-derived set of 17 people repeatedly spans public roles, investment vehicles, portfolios, advisory surfaces, and defense-company pathways. The lane preserves co-investment, sourcing, roster, portfolio, and frontier states without treating them as proof of coordination.
lanes.open_join: Fifteen of 17 frontiers remain partial or not searched; the infrastructure shows those routes instead of suppressing the entire lane.

lanes.label: USAspending defense-award acquisition
lanes.what_the_data_shows: USAspending did return official award material in two targeted workflows: 17 router award rows and 31 official rows across five NatSec100 control queries. The generic crawler maintains a separate rolling-window state; whatever that window currently contains cannot erase the targeted acquisitions.
lanes.open_join: NatSec100 company-name rows and USAspending UEIs still require source-native identity resolution before cross-corpus promotion; one router award identity is held.

lanes.label: SAM.gov defense opportunity search
lanes.what_the_data_shows: The SAM.gov route was configured for the defense-capital-policy frontier but did not execute because SAM_API_KEY was unavailable.
lanes.open_join: This is an acquisition gap. It is neither zero responsive opportunities nor evidence of absence.

lanes.label: LinkedIn public-private role-crossing signals
lanes.what_the_data_shows: The checked projection contains 430 machine-proposed role crossings, reducible to 322 distinct institutional transitions, including repeated organizations and timing patterns. All remain visible as discovery signals even though none passes the independent-receipt and endpoint-resolution gate.
lanes.open_join: The role claims are self-claimed profile evidence. Independent receipts and identity resolution are required before promotion, but their absence does not make the observed circulation pattern disappear.

lanes.label: Trump and presidential disclosure/campaign-finance lane
lanes.what_the_data_shows: A large disclosure, campaign-finance, registry, and identifier corpus exists. It preserves many unresolved candidates and explicitly records where identity, beneficial-interest, and temporal gates stop promotion.
lanes.open_join: Zero promoted crossings is the outcome of the current gate, not zero data and not a declaration that no responsive relationship exists.

lanes.label: Discovery queue and official-source frontier

crawl_source_gap_states.interpretation: Acquisition did not run; this is not a zero result.

lanes.what_the_data_shows: The repository generated at least 316 inspectable research tasks; the live target branch may contain more as official-record intake advances. Batch count varies with the configured batch size and is presentation geometry, not a research-data count. Rejections, failed routes, source gaps, and inferred scout findings remain part of the discovery map rather than disappearing from it. Source availability is reported separately from responsive records and cannot establish a zero-result search or evidence of absence.
lanes.open_join: A fanout item is a research lead or coverage state, not a verified finding; each item retains its evidence and availability labels.

cross_lane_trails.what_survives: The Clifford-authored, Starmer-adopted plan calls for state AI capacity, strategic procurement, domestic champions, and national-security collaboration. The U.S. comparator corpus independently maps a large defense-company universe and official awards.
cross_lane_trails.open_join: The comparator demonstrates the measurable machinery of supplier conversion; it does not by itself prove that a named UK Action Plan decision selected a particular U.S. company.

cross_lane_trails.what_survives: Portfolio, accelerator, investor, person-router, company-roster, and award layers repeatedly cross the same defense-company universe. The joins have explicit states ranging from source-explicit to held identity.
cross_lane_trails.open_join: Co-listing and co-investment are not coordination, and an award does not establish that an investor or router caused it.

cross_lane_trails.what_survives: Source-explicit Austin-Israel memberships, fund and portfolio overlaps, named routers, and hundreds of role-transition candidates make a personnel-capital corridor inspectable at several evidence weights.
cross_lane_trails.open_join: The evidence map does not infer national coordination, private intent, or control from geography, biography, or repeated institutional adjacency.

cross_lane_trails.what_survives: Clifford, Starmer, Thiel, Palantir, Dialog, administration-adjacent actors, and Trump disclosure records occupy connected research questions across policy, convening, company governance, procurement, personnel, and political-financial data.
cross_lane_trails.open_join: The current corpus does not contain one identifier-resolved, dated material chain joining Clifford, Thiel, Palantir, and Trump. The separate observations and the search frontier remain visible.

public_interpretation_contract.instruction: The infrastructure shows the observations, their different weights, the corridors they form, and the joins still missing. It does not collapse a large discovery corpus into the much smaller canonical hop graph, and it supplies no final verdict.

crawl_health_snapshot.interpretation: Source-file crawl health is a dated editorial snapshot. Generated views replace only fanout availability fields from committed crawl configuration and state; other lane claims remain independently validated.
